issue: The frontend README regional characterization is not established by its cited phonetic illustration.
verified_primary_scope: The main illustrated speaker originates from Biratnagar and grew up in eastern Nepal. The account describes standard literate/media speech.
decision: Preserve the pinned frontend for reproduction, but do not use its README regional characterization as a Hindi/native classification rule. Treat a profile as one pronunciation policy; native-variant support requires independent evidence.
prosody_decision: Condition pitch interpretation on segment and utterance context; pitch deviation alone cannot imply Hindi intonation.
